snippet.title: Ultimate Zombie Death Ball - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Ultimate Zombie Death Ball is a 1v1 arena sports game set in the zombie apocalypse. The object of the game is to get a ball in your opponent’s net, while being chased by a hoard of hungry zombies. 



Royalty Free Music from Bensound: www.bensound.com
